example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এঁড়ে লোক, কোনো কথাই শোনে না।
এঁড়ে লোকের সঙ্গে কাজ করা কঠিন।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a stubborn person and doesn't listen to anyone.
It's hard to work with such an obstinate fellow.
note: The term 'এঁড়ে' derives from the stubborn nature associated with mules or donkeys in rural Bengali folklore.
